notes: Core difficulty is reading three photographed snippets with exact fidelity (small, low-contrast, speckled images where OCR mangles operators/underscores/digits) and re-implementing them; a single misread character changes the computed value. Three different function shapes (loop+arithmetic, string scanning with modular char arithmetic, weighted list fold with normalization) exercise reasoning_depth; hidden probes re-run the same program with fresh arguments so hard-coded answers fail. Deterministic, no tool breadth, no resource pressure.
